set.rappels: 7 bolted rappels down the route on a single 60 m rope, after belaying pitch 8 back down; several leave under 5 ft spare, so knot the ends. Alternatively descend the East Gully.
set.rappel_count_note: Two rappel stations added in 2023 let a single 60 m rope make every rappel, some with under 5 ft to spare. Belay pitch 8 back down rather than rappelling it, to keep rock off the parties below; from the top anchor, rappel to the chain anchor right of the pitch-6 belay, then to the top of pitch 5, then down the belay stations to the ground. If the route is busy, take the East Gully instead.
set.descent_text: Most parties rappel the route on a single 60 m rope, using two rappel stations added in 2023. Belay the leader back down pitch 8 rather than rappelling it: rappelling it knocks loose rock onto anyone below. From the top anchor, rappel straight down to the chain anchor just right of the pitch-6 belay, then to the top of pitch 5, then down the belay stations to the ground, seven rappels in all. Several leave less than 5 ft of rope to spare, so knot the ends. If other parties are on the route, descend the East Gully instead: hike, downclimb and rappel the normal descent.
